newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 0.9 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 0.9 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.9 percent in the week ended February 8 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 6.2 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 1.0 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally on-plan for most retailers," the report said. "Some weather-related weakness at department stores was offset by strength at one major discounter."
The next BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales report will be issued on Wednesday, February 19, because of the upcoming President's Day holiday on Monday, February 17.
